messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — we had 3 different SIs claim Acme Corp today (overlapping outreach). This is starting to confuse the customer. Need a clear dedupe + stacking rule ASAP.
Diego: ugh, example? are these different SIs in same region or totally separate partners?
Maya: one EMEA, two NA. All claimed via partner intake form within 24h. They each kicked off outreach.
Sarah: can we add a claim-score / priority algo? eg. existing SI with active deal > new SI.
Aisha: +1 on score. also we should gate any "hotlist" accounts (top ARR or strategic) so claims require CSM approval first.
Liam: how do we enforce? Salesforce duplicate rules are messy. Prefer preventing via marketplace intake webhook before it creates claims.
marketplace-bot: new webhook event registered: `si_claim.created` -> payload includes partner_id, account_domain, contact_count, estimated_tcv.
Maya: here's a draft rule set I sketched — feedback plz:
```json
{
  "dedupe_window_days": 90,
  "priority_order": ["existing_partner_relationship", "partner_region_match", "claim_timestamp_oldest", "partner_tcv_estimate"],
  "hotlist_gate": {
    "criteria": ["ARR>1M", "strategic_tag:true"],
    "action": "require_csm_approval"
  },
  "stacking_allowed": false
}
```
Diego: makes sense. prefer stacking_allowed:false for now — stacking caused the confusion.
Sarah: tiebreaker detail: if two partners both have existing relationship, use last_active_contact_date (most recent) then partner_success_score.
Aisha: can we map to account ownership precedence: 1) Account Exec assigned 2) CSM 3) Dedicated SI partner program members 4) general SI claims. That helps sales ops.
Liam: proposed enforcement flow: marketplace intake -> run dedupe check -> if hotlist then block + send CSM approval DM -> if conflict then hold claim in queue and notify both partners with "pending" status. Example curl to ack webhook handling: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-hooks.redwood/si/claim-eval \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"account":"acme.com","partner":"partner_123"}'
```
Maya: nice. action items: (1) Diego add dedupe eval to marketplace intake (2) Aisha update partnerships playbook gating language (3) Sarah update SF duplicate rule/tiebreaker doc (4) Liam help wire webhook -> SF queue.
Diego: I can start the marketplace patch today. will stub eval and return a sample response schema.
Sarah: I'll draft the tiebreaker doc and share in #partnerships for review by EOD Fri.
Aisha: I'll update playbook and add a short flowchart for CSM approvals.
Liam: I'll prototype an internal lambda to accept `si_claim.eval` and push to SF queue.
Maya: thanks team. want this live before next week's SI enablement wave. tagging @here :eyes: for any burning concerns.
Diego: one Q — how do we surface to partners that their claim is "pending" vs "accepted"? automated email or portal status?
Aisha: portal status + short email. marketplace-bot can send partner-facing status events once we have the final API contract.
marketplace-bot: event queued: `si_claim.status.changed` when status moves from pending->accepted/rejected.
Maya: perfect. we'll iterate after first week of telemetry. I'll collate conflicts and bring sample threads to the enablement call. :white_check_mark:
